objective: Integrate the audited static/extent analysis, typed role correspondence, and validation-facing warning identity without adding a detection rule; rerun exposed development evidence and reconcile versioned results.

datasets.scoring: Preserve the named mutation and predeclared association. Unsupported is UNKNOWN, not a miss. R-ROLE may support the six prospectively specified D1P-43 WarpToad targets; no other label changes are permitted.
datasets.regression_context: D1P-42 static-only current result was 11 detected, 19 unsupported, 0 misses, 13 warning objects. This is not the expected integrated count.

datasets.scoring: Keep the D1P-41 examples and denominators versioned. Use the corrected analyzer facts and D1P-43 arm masks; UNKNOWN examples are excluded only from supported denominators and remain reported.
Use the frozen warning kind and public-index associations. No post-output label change is permitted.

Earlier must emit R-EXTENT for active_messages_count <= word_offset < messages_length. Check-added must not emit R-EXTENT because all message words are proof-bound. Other warnings are reported separately and silence is not VERIFIED_WITHIN_SCOPE.

warning_identity.legacy_ids: Preserve WNNN and ROLENNN as source IDs for historical compatibility.
warning_identity.stable_id: Hash target artifact/consumer identity, rule, and normalized semantic evidence; exclude list ordinal and source line location.
warning_identity.validation_routing: A route may match stable_id in addition to the historical target identity.

outcomes.this_run: Static warnings remain E1 and UNKNOWN unless a separately applicable preserved validation is cited as historical evidence. No warning is promoted by this rerun.

historical_reconciliation.current_vs_v1_1: Do not merge the corrected current benchmark with the historical D1P-34 16/14/0/53 result.
historical_reconciliation.payy: Report the current R-EXTENT warning as E1 known-case development evidence separately from the preserved T15-T19 real-proof committed-effect chain.
historical_reconciliation.transfer: Report project attempts and unique projects separately; do not invent family counts without lineage adjudication.
historical_reconciliation.validation: The historical 53-warning ledger grades v1.1 warnings and is not a validation of the current integrated warning set; E1+mock is not E2.

frozen_ablation_vector.note: This full per-case vector prevents equal-count case swaps from passing the completion gate.

resource_budget.memory_policy: No hard memory cap is asserted by this local runner; platform observations are descriptive only.

stop_rules: Stop before scored execution if the D2-01 content seal does not verify.
Reject environment path overrides that differ from the frozen Nargo, solc, or Payy roots; child processes receive the frozen paths explicitly.
Stop on an input hash mismatch, compiler failure outside the frozen expected negative controls, or a duplicate stable warning ID.
Preserve any partial output and report UNKNOWN; do not change rules, labels, protocols, or associations after output.
Do not open or reconstruct private reserved material.
claim_limits: Every input is exposed development material; this run does not establish transfer, unbiased discovery, prevalence, or security.
R-ROLE remains bounded source-derived semantic evidence rather than a compiler proof.
The exact Payy certificate is artifact-specific and does not transfer to mutant bytes.
No solver, proof, consumer replay, live chain, maintainer contact, or disclosure is authorized.
